commercial_status: Quote required. Job submission does not create a paid contract.

services.title: Data quality assessment
services.input: JSON object with rows: up to 200 objects with scalar values.
services.output: Missing values, duplicate rows, field types and recommendations.

services.title: Project scoping
services.input: Project brief in text. Include the problem, intended users and timing.
services.output: Scope, questions, delivery approach and quote considerations; no invented prices.

services.title: Marketing draft
services.input: Audience, channel, objective and verified facts in text.
services.output: Draft content for review. No messages sent or posts published.

services.title: Source-based research draft
services.input: Research question and supplied source extracts in text.
services.output: Analysis limited to supplied material, with gaps flagged. No autonomous web retrieval.

services.title: Governance review
services.input: System purpose, data, permissions, owners and proposed actions in text.
services.output: Controls and unresolved decisions for review.

services.title: Maintenance assessment
services.input: Sanitised logs, observed behaviour and relevant code excerpts in text.
services.output: Diagnosis and suggested changes. No shell execution or deployment.

availability: Data-quality engine implemented. Model services require a configured provider.
